descriptions.permissions: List of permissions for this module.
descriptions.features: List of features for this module.

view.title: Platform Explorer
view.description: Open the platform explorer to browse modules, entities, and permissions

allow-debug.title: Allow Debug
allow-debug.description: Enable debug mode and additional diagnostic behavior in platform dev tools

messages.select-node: Select a node from the tree.

group.title: Platform Dev Tools
group.description: Options for development-time exploration and diagnostics.

developer.title: Developer
developer.description: Controls diagnostic and debug behavior for developers using Platform Dev Tools.

debug-mode.title: Debug Mode
debug-mode.description: When enabled, the platform may emit additional diagnostic information useful during development.

communication-debug-redirect.title: Communication Debug Redirect
communication-debug-redirect.description: When Debug Mode is enabled, outbound communication deliveries are redirected to these targets instead of the original recipients.

email.title: Debug Redirect Email
email.description: All SMTP deliveries are sent to this address while Debug Mode is on. Leave empty to block email delivery in debug mode.

telegram-chat-id.title: Debug Redirect Telegram Chat ID
telegram-chat-id.description: All Telegram deliveries are sent to this chat ID while Debug Mode is on. Leave empty to block Telegram delivery in debug mode.

whatsapp-phone-number.title: Debug Redirect WhatsApp Phone Number
whatsapp-phone-number.description: All WhatsApp deliveries are sent to this E.164 phone number while Debug Mode is on. Leave empty to block WhatsApp delivery in debug mode.
